user.title: Set up Hearth
user.description: Your household's Hearth TVs pair with Home Assistant from their own settings (Settings > Home Assistant > Pair with Home Assistant). Each TV that asks shows up here to confirm.

confirm.title: Pair {name}?
confirm.description:
Check that the TV called {name} shows this code:

**{code}**

Pair it only if the codes match. A TV you don't recognize, or a code that doesn't match, may be someone else's: close this instead.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Hearth is already set up. TVs pair from their own settings.
abort.expired: This TV's request has ended. Ask again from the TV.
